text: The Taliban's "Cultural Commission" released the 11-page document in several different translations on the movement's website . Several Afghan observers say the biography is aimed at dispelling rumors of Mullah Mohammed Omar's demise . Omar is credited with founding the Taliban in the early 1990s . The document makes no mention of the U.S. helping arm and bankroll the Taliban .

Walter Scott's daughter reads a poem of love dedicated to her father . Officer Michael Slager faces life in prison or death penalty if convicted of murder . "Hate came because Walter was an African-American," the head of the church says . Scott was killed in North Charleston after getting pulled over for a broken taillight .

Daniel Boykin, 33, entered the woman's home multiple times, where he took videos, photos and other data . Police found more than 90 videos and 1,500 photos of the victim on Boykin's phone and computer . The incident happened in a TSA-only restroom, police say .

Cape Verde Islands are home to a greater number of musicians per square kilometer than any other country in the world . The Atlantic island country of just 500,000 people has a rich cultural heritage in a bid to help its economy flourish . The Kriol Jazz Festival is celebrating its seventh edition in the capital city of Praia this past weekend .

Arsenal beat Burnley 1-0 at Turf Moor to stay second in English Premier League . Aaron Ramsey scores only goal of the game to keep Arsenal in second place . Chelsea have two games in hand and play lowly Queens Park Rangers on Sunday . Aston Villa beat Tottenham 1-1 at home to keep Aston Villa in good form . Sunderland lose 4-1 to Crystal Palace .

The stars have teamed together for a #SaveTwinPeaks campaign . Sherilyn Fenn, Sheryl Lee, James Marshall, Peggy Lipton and other familiar faces from the series appear in the video . Lynch announced Sunday that he was exiting Showtime's nine-episode revival over a salary dispute .

Andrew Getty appears to have died of natural causes, police say . The coroner's preliminary assessment is there was no foul play involved in Getty's death . Andrew Getty was found on his side near a bathroom in his home, KTLA reports . The 47-year-old grandson of oil tycoon J. Paul Getty is one of the heirs to billions of oil money .

Police say Nyia Parler, 41, left her 21-year-old son in the woods while she hopped a bus to see her boyfriend in Maryland . A man walking through the woods found him Friday "lying in leaves, covered in a blanket with a Bible and a wheelchair nearby," Philadelphia police say . Parler cannot be extradited to Philadelphia until she completes an unspecified "treatment," Maryland police spokesman says .

A NASA astrophysicist has named an asteroid after Malala Yousafzai . The asteroid circles the sun between Mars and Jupiter every five and half years . It is about 4 kilometers in diameter, and its surface is very dark, the color of printer toner .

Of the ship's 2,117 passengers, 95 have suffered from vomiting, diarrhea and other symptoms . The illness has also affected five members of the 964-person crew . The CDC has yet to determine what's causing the ailments . Celebrity Cruises has been taking action since the outbreak began, including increasing cleaning and disinfection procedures .

"Dukes of Hazzard" fans mourned the loss of actor James Best . The cast of "Suicide Squad" assembled for the first time this week in a Twitter photo from director David Ayer . More than 10 million people have seen Anne Hathaway's take on Miley Cyrus' "Wrecking Ball" from Spike's "Lip Sync Battle"

Keonna Thomas, 30, also known as "Young Lioness" and "Fatayat Al Khilafah," is charged with trying to travel overseas to fight for ISIS . She's one of three women arrested this week on terror charges . Two New York women were also taken into custody .

HBO has released a teaser video for a new season of "True Detective" It stars Colin Farrell, Vince Vaughn, Rachel McAdams and Taylor Kitsch . The new season will be released June 21 . The crime drama proved to be a runaway hit in the first season .

Carlos Colina, 32, was arraigned on charges of assault and battery causing serious bodily injury and improper disposal of a body . Police were notified Saturday morning about a suspicious item along a walkway in Cambridge, Massachusetts . After that discovery, police say, a surveillance video led them to an apartment building, where more body parts were discovered .

Trey Moses was originally going to take his girlfriend, Ellie Meredith, to the prom instead . "She's great... she listens and she's easy to talk to," he says of Ellie Meredith . Ellie Meredith's mom says Ellie has struggled with friendships since elementary school, but "this school, this year has been a relief"

"A.D. The Bible Continues" is a new miniseries from Mark Burnett and Roma Downey . "Mad Men," "Louie" and "Marvel's Daredevil" are among six shows to watch this week . Billy Crystal returns to television with "The Comedians" and Josh Gad .

Mike Pence is drawing huge heat for his decision to sign a religious freedom law that opens the door to discrimination against gays and lesbians . Ruben Navarrette: Pence has scored a lot of points this week among ultraconservatives . He says there is no way a Republican can get through the pending primary without denouncing LGBT rights, which will turn Americans into single-issue voters .

Apple released a new version of its mobile operating system that includes more diversity of emojis . John Sutter: The reaction to this new lineup is, as should be expected with almost anything new in today's hypersensitive climate, a range of cheers and jeers .

Singer Avril Lavigne went missing from the music scene in December . A fan Twitter account posted a direct message from Lavigne that she was "having some health issues" Now the singer says she contracted Lyme disease and was bedridden for five months . "I thought I was dying," she tells People magazine .

Researchers re-examined archives of the Red Cross, the International Training Service and the Bergen-Belsen Memorial . They concluded that Anne and Margot Frank probably did not survive to March 1945 . Days at the camp were filled with terror and dread, witnesses said .

Ryan Calhoun and Delonte Martistee, students at Troy University, are accused of gang raping a woman in Panama City, Florida . Police found video of what appeared to be a gang rape during an investigation into an unrelated shooting . The woman in the video has been identified, but state law prevents release of information about her .

Theia is a one-year-old bully breed mix who was hit by a car and buried in a field . She was found by a worker who took her to a vet for help . She suffered a dislocated jaw, leg injuries and a caved-in sinus cavity . A fundraising page has raised enough money to pay for her treatment .

Malaysian bomb maker Zulkifli bin Hir was a member of southeast Asian terror group Jemaah Islamiyah's central command . The FBI had been offering a $5 million reward for information leading to Marwan's capture in the Philippines . Marwan had been previously reported dead after a raid by Philippine security forces in 2012 .

President Obama is giving up enormous leverage in his nuclear deal with Iran, says Julian Zelizer . Zelizer: Only reason Iran came to the negotiating table in the first place was because of tough sanctions imposed by the U.S. Congress . For Ayatollah Khamenei, the "framework" announced last week looks like a win-win: He gets to keep his nuclear infrastructure, and in return gets billions in sanctions relief .

"Mad Men" is a TV series about a 1960s advertising agency and its collision with changing times . The show has become a symbol of the times -- his and, sometimes, ours . The last season -- technically, the first half of season 7 -- ended with the moon landing in July 1969 .

Dallas Zoo giraffe Katie gave birth to a not-so-little baby (about 6 feet tall) There was no immediate word on the newborn's gender or condition . The baby joins a sister, 4-year-old calf Jamie . The zoo describes Katie as the "diva" among a herd of 12 giraffes at the zoo .

Loretta Lynch has been nominated to replace Attorney General Eric Holder since November 8 . Lynch is the U.S. attorney for the Eastern District of New York . She is the first African-American woman attorney general nominee to be confirmed to the Senate . The confirmation period between the Judiciary Committee's vote to confirm and the full Senate vote has lasted longer .

Armed assailants stormed into attorney general's office in Balkh province, northern Afghanistan . Two police officers and a security guard were among the dead . Most staff members and civilians have been rescued, but an exchange of fire between Afghan security forces and the assailants is ongoing, a statement says .

Bob Barker returned to "The Price Is Right" for the first time in eight years . The 91-year-old hosted the show for 35 years before stepping down in 2007 . Barker handled the first price-guessing game of the show, "Lucky Seven," before handing hosting duties over to Drew Carey .

"I'm feeling much better and am leaving the hospital today," B.B. King's dehydration was caused by his Type II diabetes, his daughter says . "He wasn't going to let his fans down," Claudette King's publicist says . King, 89, is short for Blues Boy, part of the name he used as a Memphis disc jockey .

Peter Bergen: Dzhokhar Tsarnaev found guilty on all counts in the Boston Marathon bombing . He says the verdict isn't surprising, but what might be the answer to how we prevent this kind of violence from happening again . To fight extremism, we don't need to reform Islam, we need to show young Muslims that extremism is doing the opposite of what it claimed to .

The Fury 325 is the tallest and fastest "giga-coaster in the world . Mike Tyson lived in a gaudy, abandoned Ohio mansion in the 1980s and '90s . Penn Jillette was part of a panel on Indiana's religious freedom law .

Pentagon releases map showing coalition forces have taken back 25-30% of Iraqi territory seized by ISIS . Counterinsurgency expert Afzal Ashraf says ISIS is very good at adapting to change . ISIS is trying to distract attention from losses by gains and attacks elsewhere, he says .

Oliver Minatel, 22, says he was sleeping on Air Canada flight when he felt something around his neck . "With a rope, something that he has, he just jumped on me. That's what happened," he says . The man was not restrained for the rest of the trip .

Former banker Rurik Jutting, 29, charged with two counts of murder in Hong Kong . Court hearing adjourned until May to determine whether there was enough evidence to proceed to trial . Police found bodies of two women and seized knife during a search of an upmarket apartment in Wan Chai .

One person is killed in Fairdale, Illinois, as a twister cuts a 22-mile path through Ogle County . A video surfaced on YouTube of a massive twister barreling across an open field, barely missing farmhouses and barns . Hail stones the size of tennis balls plummeted down on Ashton, Illinois . The National Weather Service warns of "particularly dangerous" tornadoes .

Don McLean's manuscript of "American Pie" sells for $1.2 million at auction . It's the 3rd highest auction price for an American literary manuscript, Christie's says . The draft that was auctioned is 16 pages: 237 lines of manuscript and 26 lines of typed text . McLean has said the opening lines were inspired by the death of Buddy Holly .

Pierre Krähenbühl will assess the humanitarian situation in the camp and speak with individuals about ways to relieve the suffering of the people who remain there . The Yarmouk refugee camp, which sits just 6 miles from central Damascus, has been engulfed in fighting between government and armed groups since December 2012 .

Fighting has killed hundreds in Yemen in less than two weeks . Yemen's deposed President Abdu Rabu Mansour Hadi heaped scorn on top of the airstrikes . The International Committee of the Red Cross has cried out for a humanitarian ceasefire to let aid in . The U.N. Security Council discussed the humanitarian situation at Russia's behest .

Benaud's witty one-liners from the commentary box resonated far beyond Australia's shores . Benaud led Australia into an era of world dominance as a player . He was inducted into the Sport Australia Hall of Fame in 1985 . Australian Prime Minister Tony Abbott: "To most Australians Richie Benaud was cricket"

People west of the Mississippi River will have the best view of the eclipse . It started at 3:16 a.m. Pacific Daylight Time, when the moon began moving into Earth's shadow . The total eclipse will only last four minutes and 43 seconds, making it the shortest one of the century .

Robert Durst, 71, is charged with unlawful possession of a firearm . He faces a maximum of 10 years in prison if found guilty of that charge . A Louisiana judge ruled last month that Durst will be held without bail at a facility near New Orleans . He's accused of killing his friend Susan Berman at her home in California in 2000 .

Paul Walker died in November 2013 at the age of 40 after a car crash in Los Angeles . The actor was one of the nicest guys in Hollywood . "He was a person of humility, integrity, and compassion," says Kyle Upham . "You'll feel it when you see it," says friend Vin Diesel .

Model Manuela Arbelaez accidentally revealed the correct answer to a guessing game for a new Hyundai Sonata . Host Drew Carey couldn't stop laughing . "Congratulations! Manuela just gave you a car!" he exulted . It's been a busy week for "The Price Is Right"

Thai Airways subsidiary Thai Smile unveils colorful new livery featuring characters from "Adventure Time" The airline is a subsidiary of Thailand flag carrier Thai Airways . The inaugural flight takes place on April 4, heading from Bangkok to Phuket . The plane is the result of a partnership between Thai Airways and Cartoon Network Amazone .

CNN Situation Room correspondent Brian Todd and photojournalist Khalil Abdallah were on their way to interview a legal analyst on L Street NW . "We thought it was an extraordinary situation," Todd said. "We've never seen anything like this in the middle of town"

Investigators are not expected to return to the crash site, a French national police official says . The plane crashed March 24 in rugged terrain of the Alps about 6 miles (10 kilometers) from the town of Seyne-les-Alpes . The flight data recorder, or "black box," was found Thursday by a member of the recovery team .

Cuba and the U.S. will meet at the Summit of the Americas in Panama for the first time since 1962 . The summit could provide the opportunity to push forward an agreement to re-establish formal relations and re-open embassies . Cuba's attempts to rebrand itself as an open, diverse society stumbled Wednesday when government supporters and anti-Castro supporters brawled in Panama .

In the New Testament, money gets 37 mentions, while "gold" gets 38 citations, "silver" merits 20, and "copper" four; "Coin" comes up eight times, "purse" and "denarii" -- Roman currency -- get half a dozen mentions each for a total of 119 currency referrals . Mary Magdalene and Joanna captured our attention -- one by virtue of her husband, and the other, by her stature in the story of Jesus .

California Public Utilities Commission orders PG&E to pay a record $1.6 billion penalty for unsafe operation of its gas transmission system . Most of the penalty amounts to forced spending on improving pipeline safety . A pipeline rupture in San Bruno killed eight people and injured more than 50 others in September 2010 .

Lauren Hill was diagnosed with a rare brain tumor in 2013 when she was a senior in high school . She was able to play in her first collegiate basketball game with Mount St. Joseph University . Hill helped raise $1.4 million for pediatric cancer research with nonprofit group The Cure Starts Now .

The fire broke out at the General Electric Appliance Park in Louisville, Kentucky . There were no reports of anyone injured or trapped . The park is large, such that 34 football fields could fit in one of its warehouses in the facility . Firefighters took up positions around the affected buildings, spraying water from the periphery .

Mohammad Javad Zarif is the Iranian foreign minister . He has helped secure a breakthrough in nuclear talks that could lead to an end to sanctions against Iran . Zarif received a hero's welcome as he arrived in Iran on a sunny Friday morning . But there are some facts about Zarif that are less well-known .

A Connecticut teen forced to have chemotherapy to treat Hodgkin lymphoma will remain in temporary custody of the state . The 17-year-old is in remission after nearly six months of forced chemo treatments . A Connecticut juvenile court judge issued a written decision Wednesday denying a motion to let the teen go home .

"Double Falsehood" was first published in 1728 by Lewis Theobald . The play is based on the "Cardenio" section of Don Quixote, the classic 17th-century novel by Miguel de Cervantes . Researchers analyzed 33 plays by Shakespeare, nine by Fletcher and 12 by TheobALD . They created a "psychological signature" of each author based on word choices, phrase patterns .

French prosecutor says he's not aware of any video footage from on board the plane . Two magazines, German daily Bild and French Paris Match, claim to have found a cell phone video showing the harrowing final seconds of the crash . German airline Lufthansa confirms co-pilot Andreas Lubitz had battled depression years before he took the controls of Germanwings Flight 9525 .

Emy Afalava was born in American Samoa, a U.S. territory since 1900 . He is seeking to be a citizen of American Samoans, who have been denied the right to vote . Ruben Navarrette: Since the United States was established, it adhered to the rule that those born on U.N. lands were U.s. citizens .

Listeria was found in a cup of Blue Bell ice cream produced at the Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, plant . The company is shutting down the plant "out of an abundance of caution," the company says . The warning does not affect other products made at the plant, but Blue Bell has recalled other products .

Terrorist group Al-Shabaab has claimed an attack on Garissa University College in eastern Kenya . The attack is another step in the ongoing escalation of the terrorist group's activities . It is a clear indicator that the security situation in East Africa is deteriorating fast, writes Andrew Hammond . Hammond: The group is driven by the same radical interpretation of the Koran as al-Qaeda and ISIS .

On Tuesday, a U.S. RC-135U was flying over the Baltic Sea when it was intercepted by a Russian SU-27 Flanker . The Pentagon says the Russian pilot's actions were "unsafe and unprofessional" The Pentagon and State Department will "file the appropriate petition through diplomatic channels"

Phillip Hyman grew up in the neighborhood where Walter Scott, an unarmed black man, was shot in the back several times by a white police officer in North Charleston, South Carolina, on Saturday . Hyman said he crafted the artwork as a way of mourning with the family .

Witness says he didn't see Walter Scott grab Slager's Taser . Slager has been fired and charged with murder in the death of 50-year-old Walter Scott . A bystander's cell phone video shows the five-year police veteran shooting Scott eight times as Scott runs away .

ISIS claims it controls part of Iraq's largest oil refinery . Iraqi security officials deny ISIS' claim and insist Iraqi forces remain in full control . The Baiji oil refinery refines much of the fuel used by Iraqis domestically . The refinery is just 40 kilometers (25 miles) from the northern Iraqi city of Tikrit .

Nashville's district attorney banned prosecutors from offering female sterilization in plea deals . Aaron Carroll: Nashville prosecutors have offered this option four times in the past five years . Carroll: Some have claimed this practice "evokes a dark corner of American history," but it's not that . He says even if a punishment vciolates the Constitution, it is permissible, if you willingly choose it .

More than 25,000 people, a population about the size of Key West, Florida, have fought Ebola infections over the last year . The intensity of the largest Ebola epidemic in history has died down, but dozens are still newly infected each week . Even for those who did not experience Ebola personally, the "most severe public health emergency seen in modern times" showed the world its vulnerability to disease .

The NCAA says it has no legal responsibility to ensure the academic integrity of courses offered to student-athletes at its member institutions . "They seem to talk out of both sides of their mouths," a former academic director says . The organization has been saying it's hands-off when it comes to athletics .

Six people injured in explosion at chemical plant in China's southeastern Fujian province . Plant produces paraxylene (PX), a reportedly carcinogenic chemical used in production of polyester films and fabrics . Plant hit by another explosion in July 2013, but there were no reports of casualties or toxic leaks .

Officer Michael Slager fired eight shots at Walter Scott as he fled his encounter with North Charleston police -- his back turned to the officer . Scott was shot in the back while in full retreat . Michael O'Brien: Had he known there would be video of his every move, would he have drawn his weapon on a fleeing man?

Heads of state from 35 countries in the Western Hemisphere have met every three years to discuss economic, social or political issues . The VII Summit of the Americas was supposed to be all about the symbolic handshake between the United States and Cuba . But insert Venezuela into the mix and Panama City, Panama, quickly turns into a "triangle of tension"

A nuclear submarine being repaired at a Russian shipyard caught on fire, state-run news agency reports . "The submarine is in a dry dock," a law enforcement source says . "There are no armaments or chemically active, dangerous substances, fissionable materials on it," a spokesman says .

Tropical storm Maysak is heading west in the Pacific Ocean . It's expected to make landfall Sunday morning on the southeastern coast of Isabela province . Authorities are barring outdoor activities like swimming, surfing, diving and boating in some locales, as well as precautionary evacuations .

Deion Sanders Jr. is a wide receiver at Southern Methodist University . He has gone on record with his love for "hood doughnuts," or confections from "a place in the hood" His father reminded his son he has a trust fund, condo and clothing line .

A 2012 Small Arms Survey says gender-based violence is at epidemic levels in Guatemala . The country ranks third in the killings of women worldwide, according to the U.N. According to the United Nations, two women are killed there every day . Women are particularly vulnerable because of a deep-rooted gender bias and culture of misogyny . The political will to address violence against women is slow to materialize .

Authorities in Malegaon, India, have asked residents to take a 'mugshot' of their cattle and submit it to the police . Police officials believe this is the only way to solve cow slaughter cases and enforce the law . Beef traders in the country strongly reacted to the decision and called a month-long strike .

Police in Lucknow, northern India, have bought four pepper-spraying drones for crowd control . The unmanned aircraft will be fitted with a camera and pepper spray; each drone costs between $9,560 and $19,300 . Views on the new measure are mixed, with some concerned about the suppression of freedom of speech .

Don McLean's "American Pie" sold for $1.2 million to an unnamed buyer . Bob Greene: The song is a folk ballad, beer-hall chant and high-art rock . Greene: McLean was a paperboy when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens and J.P. "The Big Bopper" died in a plane crash in 1959 . He says the song is alive and joyful, yet fretful about a world gone wrong .

Last weekend's raid in London's jewelry district feels like it has been taken from a movie like "Ocean 11" Roy Ramm, a former Scotland Yard detective, explains how such heists are organized . Ramm: In the UK burglaries and robberies are often committed by working-class people .

7-Eleven is hosting the first Bring-Your-Own-Cup Slurpee Day at U.S. stores . Customers can fill their own cup of choice for $1.49, the average cost of a medium . In-store displays with a 10-inch-diameter hole will rule out anything too large .

Rand Paul has tried to sell himself as a different type of Republican, Sen. Rand Paul says he's running for president . Rand Paul's record includes questioning landmark voting rights and civil rights legislation, says Donna Brazile . Brazile: The American people deserve a leader who won't disrespect their intelligence and won't pander to them .

The Exotic Driving Experience is a chance to drive your dream car on a racetrack . The Lamborghini's passenger, 36-year-old Gary Terry of Davenport, Florida, died at the scene . The driver of the Lamborghinis lost control of the vehicle, the Florida Highway Patrol says .

Former NFL star Aaron Hernandez is on trial for the shooting death of semi-pro player Odin Lloyd . Hernandez's fiancee revealed for the first time last week that Hernandez told her to dispose of a box from the couple's home that she said reeked of marijuana . The defense rested Monday, wrapping up its witnesses in less than a day .

Chinese authorities have formally detained Wu Rongrong and four other women's rights activists for "creating disturbances" Writer: They are young, confident, ready to challenge established norms, and most importantly, they feel responsible for society . This year marks the 20th anniversary of the influential Fourth World Conference on Women in Beijing .

Former Maryland governor Martin O'Malley says Hillary Clinton was "inevitable" to win the nomination in 2008 but ended up losing to Barack Obama . Clinton plans to launch her presidential candidacy on Sunday through a video message on social media, a source close to her campaign-in-waiting told CNN .

Odin Lloyd was 27-years-old and working for a landscaping firm when he was killed in June 2013 . He played football for the Boston Bandits, the oldest semi-pro team in Boston and the winner of four championships in the New England Football League . "Odin was the backbone of the family. Odin was the man of the house," his mother said .

Ted Cruz is hoping to energize Iowa's evangelical base . Cruz's first television ads are appearing this weekend during programs on Fox News and NBC that are pegged to Easter Sunday . Cruz has built a brand as a stalwart conservative willing to buck GOP leadership on fiscal issues, but he's also interested in social issues .

Paul Bettany's "Avengers: Age of Ultron" poster has been released . The actor is set to join the cast in the movie's sequel to "The Avengers" He looks like a member of the superhero group for many years in the comics . Thursday was the eve of the new Netflix series "Daredevil," and after a photoshopped first look at Charlie Cox's iconic red Daredevil suit, Marvel put out a video of the real one .

In the first three months of 2015, Italy registered more than 10,000 migrants arriving . Most migrants recorded this year come from countries in West Africa as well as Somalia and Syria . At least 480 migrants have died while crossing the Mediterranean since the beginning of the year, the IMO says .

French-language TV network TV5Monde is gradually regaining control of its channels and social media outlets . The outage began around 8:45 p.m. Paris time Wednesday . The network says it was "hacked by an Islamist group," but there was no immediate claim of responsibility .

David Lynch has confirmed he will no longer direct the revival of "Twin Peaks" He tweeted that the show's third season will continue without him . Showtime Network said they were "saddened" by Lynch's decision . The cult 1990s TV series was set to return in 2016 .

In Louisville, Kentucky, Sen. Rand Paul announces he will run for president . In Chicago, voters head to the polls in a surprising runoff between Mayor Rahm Emanuel and challenger Jesus "Chuy" Garcia . In Ferguson, Missouri, the shadow of Michael Brown and the protests over his shooting by Officer Darren Wilson will loom large .

A tornado may have touched down in Potosi, Missouri, about 70 miles from St. Louis . "Nighttime tornadoes are the most deadly," says severe weather expert Chad Myers . More storms are expected in the Midwest, Mississippi River Valley, Tennessee River Valley and near the southern Great Lakes .

Jodi Arias was sentenced to life in prison Monday for the 2008 murder of her ex-boyfriend Travis Alexander . Arias, 34, was found guilty of first-degree murder in May 2013 . The jury that convicted her found the murder was especially cruel, making Arias eligible for the death penalty .

Paramedics were called last week to a rented villa at the Sirenusa resort in St. John after the family of four fell ill . The use of methyl bromide is restricted in the United States because of its acute toxicity . The EPA is working with local government agencies to investigate whether the family was made ill after a fumigation at the resort .

Dean Obeidallah: Rolling Stone article about alleged gang rape at University of Virginia was flawed . He says the law of defamation must be balanced against freedom of speech protected under First Amendment . He asks: Can UVA, Phi Kappa Psi or any of the other fraternities on campus sue for defamation? Obeydallah: True statements cannot be defamatory; Virginia Supreme Court said in Jordan v. Kollman .

Kevone Charleston, 36, is suspected of involvement in 32 commercial robberies dating to November 2013 . He was shot and wounded by FBI agents and task force officers, but his injuries are not life threatening, sheriff's deputy says . Two agents were injured in a crash and the suspect was shot before being captured .

Alaska Airlines Flight 448 was just barely on its way to Los Angeles from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport . The pilot reported hearing unusual banging from the cargo hold . "There could be a person in there so we're going to come back around," he told air traffic control . The man turned out to be a ramp agent from a contractor that handles loading the luggage .

Craig Hicks, 46, is charged in the deaths of three Muslim college students in Chapel Hill, North Carolina . A judge ruled Monday that Hicks' case is "death penalty qualified," CNN affiliates reported . The victims' family members have called on authorities to investigate the slayings as a hate crime .

Amnesty International report is calling for authorities to address the number of attacks on women's rights activists in Afghanistan . The report, entitled "Their Lives on the Line," examines the persecution of activists . Amnesty's Horia Mosadiq: Perpetrators almost always walk free, and threats reported by women rights defenders are often simply ignored .

A New York judge issued an opinion authorizing service of divorce papers on a husband completely via Facebook . The law of service of process has evolved this way: the ideal and fairest way to notify a person of a lawsuit is to have another human hand the papers to the defendant in person, and have some proof that the person was the defendant .

The Rev. Robert H. Schuller was diagnosed with esophageal cancer in August 2013 . He was also the founder of Crystal Cathedral megachurch in Orange County, California . His show, "Hour of Power," reached millions, making him a televangelist before the term became tarnished .

Mexican state oil company Pemex says 45 workers were injured in the blaze . Two of them are in serious condition, the company says . Authorities evacuated about 300 people from the Abkatun Permanente platform after the fire started . The fire began in the platform's dehydration and pumping area .

The law bans what it describes as "dismemberment abortion" It defines as "knowingly dismembering a living unborn child and extracting such unborn child one piece at a time from the uterus" The law allows for the procedure if "necessary to protect the life or health of the mother"

Bi Fujian, who works for state-run China Central Television, was filmed at a dinner party singing a revolutionary song that eulogizes the Communist Party's early years . "The Communist Party, Chairman Mao. Don't mention that old son of a b***h. He made us suffer so bad," he said . Bi later apologized, saying: "My personal speech has led to grave social consequences"

Kentucky guard Andrew Harrison said of Wisconsin star Frank Kaminsky, "F**k that (N-word) Harrison said his words were "in jest," and that he meant no disrespect to Kaminsky . "I immediately called big frank to apologize and let him know I didn't mean any disrespect," Harrison tweeted .

"Arrested Development" executive producer Brian Grazer said the show will return for a fifth season of 17 episodes . The fourth season was streamed exclusively on Netflix in 2013, after Fox canceled the show several years before . It was not yet known if the full cast, including Jason Bateman, Michael Cera and Will Arnett, will return .

The Large Hadron Collider (LHC) is the largest particle accelerator in the world . The LHC generates up to 600 million particles per second, with a beam circulating for 10 hours, traveling more than 6 billion miles . It took thousands of scientists, engineers and technicians decades to devise and build the particle accelerator .

Iranian military observation aircraft flew within 50 yards of an armed U.S. Navy helicopter over the Persian Gulf this month . The incident sparked concern that top Iranian commanders might not be in full control of local forces . The Navy helicopter was flying from the deck of the USS Carl Vinson on a routine patrol in international airspace .

Jurors found Dzhokhar Tsarnaev guilty of all 30 counts in the Boston Marathon bombing trial . Seventeen of the 30 counts were capital charges, meaning he is eligible for the death penalty . The trial will next move into a penalty phase, where the jury will hear testimony and arguments from both sides .

Education minister Smriti Irani was visiting a FabIndia outlet in the tourist resort state of Goa . She spotted a security camera overlooking the changing room of one of the stores, police say . The arrested staff have been charged with voyeurism and breach of privacy .

Iranian authorities imposed a ban on women attending men's sports events after the Islamic Revolution in 1979 . It's not clear exactly which games women will be able to attend . FIFA President Sepp Blatter called on Iran last month to end its "intolerable" ban .

Ramalinga Raju was the former chairman of software services exporter Satyam Computers Services . In 2009, he admitted inflating profits with fictitious assets and nonexistent cash . The case has been compared to the Enron Corp. scandal, in which a Houston energy company's earnings had been overstated by several hundred million dollars .

Elizabeth Sedway says she was removed from a Hawaii flight because she didn't have a doctor's note saying she could fly . "You're taking me off the airplane because ... I have cancer and no note to fly," she says in a video posted to Facebook . Alaska Airlines apologizes for "the situation could have been handled differently," a spokeswoman says .

Kayahan was one of Turkey's best-loved singers and songwriters . He died Friday in a hospital in Istanbul, five days after his 66th birthday . In 1990, he competed in the Eurovision Song Contest, finishing 17th . His final album, "I Made a Vow," was released in 2007 .
